headRight.text: Three states of the gallery route at 1440 pixels, each cut from a capture at two times device scale to the region that carries it. Every crop follows the deck theme.

items.caption: The grid view (G) closes the sidebar and lays every direction out as a captured tile under its group heading, with the shipped site first. The crop shows two of four columns.
The index panel (R) opens on This site and lists every page in groups. Each row carries a capture, an address and one line; this crop shows the first three rows.
The search palette (Cmd K) opens as a map of the site, and each row shows its address. Typing one letter reaches every heading, direction, archived version and deck slide.
